title: Assessing Interpretability Completeness: What Fraction of Behavioral Variance Do Identified Circuits Explain?
original_idea: On GPT-2 Small, run full model and IOI circuit-only model on 200 novel IOI prompts. Compute KL divergence between output distributions. Examine whether residual divergence correlates with input features.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying the completeness gap of the best-documented circuit is valuable meta-interpretability. Directly informs whether circuits are certifiable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: IOI circuit is well-documented with existing TransformerLens code. KL divergence is a standard metric. Novel IOI prompts are easy to generate. Very accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One circuit, one model, 200 prompts, KL divergence metric, correlation analysis. Extremely focused.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
